resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Vietnamese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Vietnamese pass identified 25 actionable capitalization, false-friend, grammar, electrical, circuit, thermal, and safety-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Vietnamese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm-law display name was unnecessarily lowercased.
evidence: The previous display name was định luật Ohm.
findings.resolution: Capitalized it as Định luật Ohm.

findings.summary: The first worked-example title translated current as the present moment.
evidence: The previous title was Tìm hiện tại.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Tìm dòng điện.

findings.summary: The resistance example setup had unnatural Vietnamese sentence structure and omitted unit spacing.
evidence: The previous setup described a circuit with 12V and 2A as Một đoạn mạch có hiệu điện thế 12V chạy qua thì có dòng điện 2A.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a circuit with 12 V voltage and 2 A current.

findings.summary: The power paragraph translated thermal headroom as thermal power and space.
evidence: The previous paragraph used công suất nhiệt và khoảng trống for safe heat dissipation.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with sufficient heat-dissipation capability and an appropriate safety margin.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current turned resistance into heat.
evidence: The previous summary was Làm thế nào dòng điện biến điện trở thành nhiệt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to electrical energy being converted to heat by current.

findings.summary: The existing correction still used a less precise literal heating term.
evidence: The previous overlay title was Công suất gia nhiệt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the standard thermal phrase Công suất tỏa nhiệt.

findings.summary: The setup used mang 3 A, which is less natural for current through a coil.
evidence: The previous setup was Một cuộn dây 0,8 Ω mang 3 A.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a coil with 0.8 Ω resistance conducting 3 A.

findings.summary: The heading was an awkward literal question about heating.
evidence: The previous title was Điều gì ảnh hưởng đến sưởi ấm.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Các yếu tố ảnh hưởng đến sự tỏa nhiệt.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet used phần cứng for hardware.
evidence: The previous text referred to heat transfer to không khí, chất lỏng và phần cứng.
findings.resolution: Changed phần cứng to the technically appropriate thiết bị.

findings.summary: The paragraph incorrectly called electrical power a rate of energy transfer while labeling it electrical energy.
evidence: The previous paragraph began Năng lượng điện là tốc độ truyền năng lượng.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to distinguish electrical power, temperature, heat capacity, and heat-flux density.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph translated safety margin as physical empty space.
evidence: The previous text used khoảng không thích hợp for component safety.
findings.resolution: Changed it to biên độ an toàn thích hợp and clarified the equipment checks.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff display name was unnecessarily lowercased and singular.
evidence: The previous display name was định luật Kirchhoff.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Các định luật Kirchhoff.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading omitted điện and was too generic.
evidence: The previous title was Thuật ngữ mạch.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Thuật ngữ mạch điện.

findings.summary: The introductory sentence was an ungrammatical literal translation.
evidence: The previous text said the terms made a circuit diagram easier to reason about using dễ lý giải hơn về.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a natural introduction to analyzing an electrical schematic.

findings.summary: The series-resistor example title translated resistor as a current phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Dòng điện trở.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Các điện trở mắc nối tiếp.

findings.summary: The series-resistor conclusion lacked a subject and read like a literal machine translation.
evidence: The previous conclusion was 20 A giống nhau đi qua cả hai điện trở.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as the same 20 A current passing through both resistors.

findings.summary: The cells heading used a literal word that is misleading for battery cells.
evidence: The previous title was Các tế bào nối tiếp và song song.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Các cell mắc nối tiếp và song song.

findings.summary: The series-cell bullet called ampere-hour capacity power and used an unclear equal-cell phrase.
evidence: The previous text used công suất ampe giờ and một ô bằng nhau.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with dung lượng tính bằng ampe-giờ and a clear equivalent-cell reference.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell bullet translated capacity as power.
evidence: The previous text said công suất và dòng điện khả dụng tăng thêm xấp xỉ.
findings.resolution: Changed it to dung lượng and clarified approximate addition.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning was grammatically awkward and less specific about cell-level monitoring.
evidence: The previous text was Việc sạc lithium-ion nối tiếp yêu cầu giám sát ở cấp độ tế bào.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as series charging of lithium-ion cells with per-cell monitoring and protection.

findings.summary: The circuit-limits paragraph mistranslated high-current circuitry as high-voltage circuitry.
evidence: The previous ending was mạch điện cao thế.
findings.resolution: Changed it to mạch dòng điện lớn and retained the omitted-behavior warning.

findings.summary: The TCR display name used kháng nhiệt độ, a literal and misleading phrase.
evidence: The previous display name was Hệ số kháng nhiệt độ (TCR).
findings.resolution: Changed it to Hệ số nhiệt độ của điện trở (TCR).

findings.summary: The trigonometry display name was lowercased at the start.
evidence: The previous display name was lượng giác.
findings.resolution: Capitalized it as Lượng giác.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity display name was translated as thermal power.
evidence: The previous display name was công suất nhiệt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the correct Vietnamese term Nhiệt dung.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the per-area density meaning.
evidence: The previous display name was dòng nhiệt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Mật độ dòng nhiệt.
